name: beat-title-cards
title: Beat Title Cards
description: Kinetic title cards that cut on a beat. Every beat swaps the word with a crisp snap scale, every few beats a card is inverted for emphasis, and the last word stays on screen. The words cycle from one variable and the cut rate follows the bpm variable, so it can be laid on music.
useWhen: A hook or a list of selling points cut to a music beat.
A fast opener of 3 to 6 short words.
avoidWhen: A sentence that must be read in one go: use a typewriter or per-character block.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words separated by | or new lines; they cycle, one per beat. Short words work best.

variables.label: Beats per minute
variables.description: How fast the cards cut. 120 is one cut every half second.

variables.label: Invert every
variables.description: Every Nth card is inverted. 0 turns it off.

variables.label: Last word
variables.description: Optional word that replaces the final beat, e.g. a shop name. Empty keeps the cycle.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: The final word and the current beat tick: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
